In prose it also rises on words that set up a comparison ('compared', 'difference between', 'the two/three ...', 'both groups'), and it stays weak (below about 0.5 of max) on ordinary narrative tokens and on non-operator words placed between operands (e.g. 'and' in a Go expression).
